units.source_text: 凭你刚才的这番话，我就明白你的关键所在。

en.t: From what you just said, I understand where your real weakness lies.

units.source_text: 女人之所以化妆，同机器人戴人的假面具是一样的道理，简直愚蠢到家嘛。

en.t: The reason women wear makeup is the same as a robot putting on a human mask; it is utterly foolish.

units.source_text: 植物的花、鸟的歌声也一样。

en.t: The flowers of plants and the songs of birds are the same.

units.source_text: 曾记得你说过，从鸡的体内把鸡心切离，泡在培养液里，可以存活八年。

en.t: I remember you once said that if a chicken heart is cut out of the chicken and soaked in a culture solution, it can live for eight years.

units.source_text: 你还认为，甚至把子宫泡在培养液里，让它存活下去的话，就可以不要女人。

en.t: You also thought that if even a womb could be kept alive by soaking it in a culture solution, then women would no longer be needed.

units.source_text: 阿米巴变形虫那样的单细胞生物的生殖，才是质朴无华的，

en.t: Only the reproduction of single-celled organisms like amoebas is simple and unadorned,

units.source_text: 生物的进化都是很虚荣的。”

en.t: while the evolution of living things is all terribly vain.
